If the web services component is enabled on the AP, an attacker can perform cross-site request forgery (CSRF) or remote code execution (RCE). This vulnerability impacts Ruckus ZoneDirector, SmartZone, and Solo APs.

CVE-2023-29336.d: Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation up to SYSTEM privileges.

CVE-2023-21839.d: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3, IIOP, to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.

CVE-2023-1389.n: TP-Link Archer AX-21 Command Injection Vulnerability
CVE-2023-1389.d: TP-Link Archer AX-21 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

CVE-2023-28432.d: MinIO contains a vulnerability in a cluster deployment where MinIO returns all environment variables, which allows for information disclosure.

CVE-2023-27350.n: PaperCut MF/NG Improper Access Control Vulnerability
CVE-2023-27350.d: PaperCut MF/NG contains an improper access control vulnerability within the SetupCompleted class that allows authentication bypass and code execution in the context of system.

CVE-2023-2136.n: Google Chrome Skia Integer Overflow Vulnerability
CVE-2023-2136.d: Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

CVE-2023-2033.n: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
CVE-2023-2033.d: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

CVE-2023-29492.d: Novi Survey contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the server in the context of the service account.

CVE-2023-20963.d: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation after updating an app to a higher Target SDK with no additional execution privileges needed.

CVE-2023-28252.n: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2023-28252.d: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

CVE-2023-28206.n: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS IOSurfaceAccelerator Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
CVE-2023-28206.d: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS IOSurfaceAccelerator contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows an app to execute code with kernel privileges.

CVE-2023-28205.n: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Use-After-Free Vulnerability
CVE-2023-28205.d: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

CVE-2023-26083.n: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Information Disclosure Vulnerability
CVE-2023-26083.d: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows a non-privileged user to make valid GPU processing operations that expose sensitive kernel metadata.

CVE-2023-0266.d: Linux kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation to gain ring0 access from the system user.

CVE-2023-26360.n: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
CVE-2023-26360.d: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

CVE-2023-24880.n: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
CVE-2023-24880.d: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

CVE-2023-23397.n: Microsoft Office Outlook Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2023-23397.d: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows for a NTLM Relay attack against another service to authenticate as the user.

CVE-2023-23529.n: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Type Confusion Vulnerability
CVE-2023-23529.d: Apple iOS, MacOS, Safari and iPadOS WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

CVE-2023-23376.n: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2023-23376.d: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

CVE-2023-21823.n: Microsoft Windows Graphic Component Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2023-21823.d: Microsoft Windows Graphic Component contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

CVE-2023-21715.n: Microsoft Office Publisher Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
CVE-2023-21715.d: Microsoft Office Publisher contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows for a local, authenticated attack on a targeted system.

CVE-2023-0669.n: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2023-0669.d: Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

CVE-2023-22952.d: Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

CVE-2023-21674.n: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2023-21674.d: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.
